title: Boom Bap Brawl
author: Hot-Cartoonist4428
selftext: I’m making this post to let everyone know that there is a new way to make AI assisted games. With the new Claude Fable 5 in Higgsfield you can make your game like never before in AI. With this combination and a good prompt you can make games like never before. When you build a game this way you can see your code, assets, and artwork coming together on one page. Let me know what you think about this after you finish.

comments.author: thewowcollector
comments.body: Where did the art come from?

comments.author: Hot-Cartoonist4428
comments.body: Art is generated in higgsfield.gg when Claude Fable 5 is linked, then your prompt and it creates the artwork, assets and codes.

comments.author: MikesWorldNYC
comments.body: You need to add hitboxes to the arms. But that is good stuff.

comments.author: Hot-Cartoonist4428
comments.body: Per MikesWorldNYC I’ve added hitboxes to the arms. Give it a shot on your PC @ dusky-village-171.higgsfield.gg

replies.author: promptling
replies.body: Adding the arm hitboxes is a good response to feedback. For the next pass, ask testers to capture three moments: a hit that felt fair, a miss that looked like contact, and any attack that connected from too far away. Those examples will tell you whether the issue is collision size, animation timing, or camera perspective. Full disclosure, I am building [Patchloop](https://patchloop.io/) for agentically built games in progress and repeat playtests. Boom Bap Brawl would be a neat fit for a focused combat feel test.

comments.author: chum_is-fum
comments.body: You can use LTX2 director to interpolate between the poses so you aren't stuck with still images it works very well if you have consistent keyframes.

comments.author: VR38DET
comments.body: The pixel art style is pretty generic for these ai models. Try and find your own style and use gpt image or something to make it

replies.author: Hot-Cartoonist4428
replies.body: Thanks, I’ll try that next time.

replies.author: VR38DET
replies.body: I suggest going on aesthetics wiki and combine aesthetics you like with pixel art and ask it to make whatever image you like in that style. even link the wiki page for the aesthetic into the prompt
